officialRuleFacts.ownBolan: At owner play-phase start, optionally choose one of three random skills, retained until that exact play phase ends.
officialRuleFacts.foreignBolan: The other role may invoke once in its play phase and lose1HP; Zhong Yan selects the offered skill and the payer obtains it until that same play phase ends. The payment is HP loss, not damage.
officialRuleFacts.yifa: After another role designates Zhong Yan with Slash or a black ordinary trick, that actor hand limit decreases by1 until that actor turn ends. No once-per-turn limit is printed.
officialRuleFacts.dangxianFix: Official2021-11-24 update acknowledges a BoLan/DangXian interaction repair but gives no detailed timing ruling.

Complete member semantic/version mapping and correct phase-limited activations; current turn-limited classic:qiangxi/ol:daoshu cannot silently stand for phase-limited versions.

Random distribution/order and the current complete server pool IDs are not established by these sources.

Yifa outside the actor turn, target redirection and effective-black-color freeze require an exact owning turn/color mapping; source text alone does not define internal frame timing.

Foreign payer loses1HP once, Zhong Yan rather than payer chooses; wrong actor rejected; HP/dying cold children resume once.
Grant usable only in exact originating play phase; normal/extra/forced phase end expires it and permanent copies survive.
All chosen pool IDs use their documented versions and phase quotas, without arbitrary same-name substitution or a reduced subset.
Yifa real Slash/black instant trick, foreign actor, repeated stacking, effective color and exact actor-turn expiry.
